index.mode_pill_title: Tap: USB-D ⇄ LSB-D (USB → USB-D, LSB → LSB-D, other mode → USB-D)
index.net_bar_title: Link with the station: tap for details
index.host_bar_title: Station computer: tap for the hardware summary
index.presence_title: Receive-only visitors: tap to see the list
index.freq_title: Tap to enter a frequency; drag a digit up or down to adjust it
index.txzone_title: Tap (or double-tap) to show the received audio waterfall
index.wf_plot_title: Tap (or double-tap) to return to the power graphs
index.wf_width_title: Audio band shown, from 0 Hz to N kHz
index.ctl_preamp_title: Preamp: off, then each value of the rig
index.ctl_notch_title: Notch: off, auto, manual (long press or double click: settings)
index.ctl_pwr_title: Transmit power: 5, 10, 25, 50, 80, 100 % then back to the start
index.stop_title: Press: immediate return to receive. Hold 3 s: disconnect or power off the TRX remotely
index.mini_wf_on_title: Small HF waterfall above the bands: shown or hidden
index.sel_ind_title: Station SELCALL: tap to open its panel
index.voice_direct_title: Equalizer and voice effects: on / off (settings: "Parametric equalizer" section)
index.st_direct_title: Stereo spatialisation of received audio (headphones): on / off; long press: settings
index.scr_ind_title: Scrambler on: tap to open its section
index.bzh_ind_title: Breizh Audio Box: tap to open its section
index.fdv_ind_title: FreeDV: tap to open its section
index.dif_ind_title: Live broadcast: tap to open its section
index.blk_clar_title: Clarifier offset (ΔTX / XIT: shifts TRANSMIT; RIT: receive); refused while transmitting
index.local_release_title: Unlocks remote PTT before the wait ends (impossible during a transmission from the rig's microphone)
index.power_on_title: Powers the rig on through CAT (serial ports checked by the station); no transmission
index.hf_dock_on_label_title: Large landscape screen: the rig's HF spectrum stays shown at the top of the right column (uses data while shown)
index.audio_dock_on_label_title: Large landscape screen: the received audio spectrum stays shown below these settings (computed by the browser, no extra network data)
index.password_not_saved: This page never saves the password: use your browser's password manager.
index.ignore_rig_warning_label: This is not the rig: ignore the warning
index.mic_cuts_hint: Voice dropouts while transmitting: try "quiet room" or a "headset" profile (browser noise reduction off). Mic gain and adjustable noise gate: "Parametric equalizer" section.
index.keep_awake_label: Keep the screen on while I am connected (HTTPS required)
index.link_sounds_help: Two falling notes: link lost (repeated while reconnecting). Two rising notes: link restored, the station is in receive. Three low notes: reconnection impossible. The phone also vibrates.
index.password_session: The password is kept in the page's memory for the session (never saved): it is not asked again while reconnecting, but it is after the page is reloaded.
index.loss_open: Details of the last connection loss
index.insecure_intro: Page over HTTP: the browser blocks the microphone (a browser rule that no page can get around). Reception and controls work. To transmit from this browser:
index.insecure_https_part1: open the station over HTTPS (self-signed certificate:
index.console_intro: Set up and troubleshoot the station from this browser: same menus as TRX Console. Log in with your username and password; the station's sudo password is asked once, at the first administration menu.
index.blk_miniwf_title: Small HF waterfall of the rig: tap for its settings
index.mem_fav_label: ★ Favourite (shown at the top of the list)
index.mem_empty: No memory. Tune the rig, then "Store the current frequency".
index.sdr_wf_title: Tap: frequency read under the finger; double click: the SDR listens to this frequency
index.sdr_here_title: Listen to this frequency with the SDR
index.sdr_qsy_title: The TRX moves to the frequency LISTENED TO on the SDR (refused while transmitting)
index.sdr_qsy_rev_title: The SDR listens to the TRX frequency (the waterfall follows if it leaves the window)
index.sdr_listen_title: SDR audio; muted by the station during any transmission
index.sdr_sql_label_title: SDR squelch: dB above noise; 0 = always open
index.sdr_dfreq_label_title: Frequency to listen to; the waterfall centre follows if it leaves the window
index.sdr_bal_label_title: Balance of the two sources when listening to the SDR: left = TRX only, right = SDR only
index.sdr_split_label_title: With headphones: each source in one ear (exclusive with ST spatialisation)
index.sdr_palette_title: SDR waterfall colours (kept in this browser)
index.sdr_spots_title: DX Cluster spots on the SDR waterfall; tap a spot: the SDR listens to it (the TRX does not move)
index.sdr_fs_label_title: Width covered by the SDR; the largest is set on the station (menu 2.4). The SDR restarts (one to two seconds).
index.sdr_ant_box_title: SDR antenna input (RSP2). The SDR restarts (one to two seconds).
index.sdr_zoom_in_title: Zoom in around the listening frequency
index.sdr_rf_label_title: SDR preamplifier (LNA): 8 = maximum gain. Overload: lower it.
index.sdr_agc_label_title: IF AGC: the SDR sets the IF gain itself
index.sdr_if_box_title: IF gain, set by hand when "Auto IF" is off
index.sdr_intro: SDR receiver alongside the TRX, receive only. Sliders apply while being dragged; on OVERLOAD, lower the RF gain. The SDR never acts on the rig.
index.fr_back_title: Return to the frequency and mode used before the QSY to a friend
index.friends_intro: A group of friends sees who is active on their station. The presence relay only sees encrypted states; a QSY to a friend is done in receive, after confirmation, never during a transmission.
index.monitoring_intro: Help an operator in trouble, or get help, without VPN or open port: the helped station sends what ITS operator has chosen, always masked and encrypted through the relay. The helping station can only read and request; nothing controls the rig. Same actions as menu 6.5 of TRX Console.
index.dif_user_label: Listeners of the private broadcast: username
index.tx_holes_title: Packets of your voice that reached the station too late (network): each one makes a small gap in the transmission. If it does not change during a dropout, the cause is the microphone processing.
index.tx_holes_label: Gaps in the transmission (network), since the station started:
index.beeps_title: End-of-transmission beeps — generated and TRANSMITTED by the station, setting shared by all devices.
index.spatial_intro: Makes received audio stereo on headphones: listening comfort, voice in the centre, hiss around. Processed on this device only: the station still sends mono audio only. Without headphones (single speaker, Bluetooth headset in call mode), tick "Mono output".
index.st_ab_title: Hold down: mono listening, to compare
index.voice_intro: Processing of YOUR voice on this device, before it is sent to the station (useful in USB-D: the rig's equalizer does not act there). A limiter is always active. Settings kept by this browser.
index.voice_mic_title: Microphone (active even with the equalizer off)
index.voice_gate_hint: Set the threshold just above the background level (mark on the meter), below your voice level. Too high: clipped syllables.
index.voice_profile_save_title: Stores the current settings (equalizer, chorus, reverb) on the station, for this account
index.voice_graph_title: Equalizer curve: above 0 dB boosted (warm), below cut (cold); bluish zone = speech
index.voice_fx_hint: In SSB, chorus and reverb reduce intelligibility: use with care. They are cut off instantly on return to receive.
index.voice_monitor_label: Monitoring (HEADPHONES required: on a speaker, feedback howl)
index.voice_monitor_hint: Monitoring and playback: on this device only, NEVER sent to the station; impossible while transmitting. Available once connected with the microphone.
index.replay_intro_part2: s max), then sends it back on transmit. Microphone muted during the replay, monitored on this device. Replaying a station to third parties is generally prohibited: at your own responsibility.
index.selcall_intro: Station digital squelch by group call: armed on a code, it mutes received audio until a station of the group sends this code, then leaves it open until you re-arm. Setting shared by all your devices.
index.sel_tail_row: Send the burst at the end of transmission (instead of the roger beep; TRANSMITTED by the station)
index.sel_send_title: Group call without speaking: the station TRANSMITS the burst of the armed code several times
index.sel_calibrate_title: Transmits a 1,000 Hz tone that rises in steps while watching the ALC, then sets the level
index.sel_calibrate_hint: The automatic setting TRANSMITS a tone for up to 18 s (power set on the rig): into a dummy load or on a free frequency, with "Transmit allowed" ticked. Cancel = STOP.
index.sel_test_hint: Made here, without the station: 2 s of silence then the burst 3 times. Send it as a DOCUMENT (not as a voice message); the other operator plays it into the microphone of their rig, medium volume, while transmitting, and identifies.
index.fdva_touch_hint: Tap a frequency to go there (USB if the rig is not in upper sideband).
index.breizh_apply_hint: Settings apply at the next transmission, never during one. This device's equalizer, chorus, reverb and scrambler are off when the voice goes through Breizh.
index.scrambler_warning: The scrambler makes your voice unintelligible to anyone without the same setting. It is NOT encryption: anyone with an identical scrambler hears you. On amateur radio bands, the Radio Regulations (ITU, Art. 25) and national regulations prohibit transmissions intended to obscure the meaning of messages: you take full responsibility. Always off when the page opens.
index.scrambler_hint: Same mode on both sides. Added delay: about 43 ms. If the voice stays scrambled in SSB, adjust the fine offset (or the rig's RIT). SELCALL tones and station beeps are not scrambled.
index.swr_intro: The station transmits a short FM carrier on each point (normal transmit keying: "Transmit allowed" on, STOP always possible), tuner off, then restores the rig.
index.net_export_title: Anonymous zip of the last 30 days (report and data, without account, address or position) to send to the development team
index.instruments_empty: Nothing to show: the rig does not provide these meters, or the link is down.
index.layout_select_auto: Automatic (landscape if the screen is wide)
index.cluster_all_title: The last 30 spots received, all bands
index.bug_intro: Describe what happened, then prepare the report: it contains the version, the device, the state of the link and the rig, the last connection losses and the page log. Never a password. You review it before sending.
index.bug_text_hint: e.g. the waterfall stays black after changing band
index.bug_send_title: Stored on the station: it will be attached to the TRX Console troubleshooting report (menu 6.3)
index.kp_preview: kHz if 1000 or more, otherwise MHz (e.g. 7074 or 14.205)
index.mini_display_title: Display (browser, shared with the large spectrum)
index.swr_dialog_hint: If a setting was not restored, correct it by hand on the rig or in the page.
index.hf_spots_title: Show or hide DX Cluster spots on the spectrum
index.hf_list_title: List of spots on the band
index.hf_vfo_title: Finger tuning: while it is lit, dragging the spectrum changes the frequency (like the VFO)
index.hf_range_title: Contrast: span from black to white, in dB (80 = the rig's full scale; otherwise, black follows the noise)
index.hf_hot_title: Colours by S level: yellow above S7, orange above S9, red above S9+20 (aligned with the S-meter, approximate); off = relative colours
index.hf_rig_title: Settings of the rig's own spectrum (refused while transmitting)
index.hf_set_mode_title: Spectrum mode: centred on the frequency or fixed edges
index.hf_set_span_title: Width shown (centred mode): narrower = more detail
index.hf_plot_title: Rig HF spectrum: tap = tune (to the kHz); "Close" to return to the power graphs
index.spot_qsy_title: Put the rig on the spot's frequency (and mode); refused while transmitting
layout.rotate: Rotate the device: this interface is designed for landscape.
layout.locked_missing: This profile is incomplete (safety widgets missing): it cannot be displayed.
layout.no_variant_phone: This profile has no interface for a smartphone: add one with the designer, or go back to the factory interface.
layout.no_variant_tablet: This profile has no interface for a tablet: add one with the designer, or go back to the factory interface.
layout.no_variant_desktop: This profile has no interface for a computer: add one with the designer, or go back to the factory interface.
layout.no_variant_other: This profile has no interface for a device: add one with the designer, or go back to the factory interface.
sdr.code_absent: SDR not found (unplugged, or wrong serial number in [sdr] serial)
sdr.code_busy: SDR already in use by another application
sdr.code_service: manufacturer service unreachable (SDRplay API installed? sdrplay.service?)
sdr.code_core_missing: sdr-core program missing (run the installation again after the manufacturer's API)
sdr.code_config: setting refused by sdr-core (see [sdr] in station.toml)
sdr.code_access: RTL-SDR dongle unreadable by the station (USB permissions: run the station installation again)
sdr.code_duplicate: duplicate serial number (two identical RTL-SDR dongles: rewrite one)
sdr.state_suspended: SDR SUSPENDED by the station: {reason} (automatic resume when load drops)
sdr.load_text: Throttled (level {level}: {what}){reason}. One step is restored after 5 quiet minutes.
client.temp_hot: TRANSCEIVER TOO HOT ({temp}): remote transmission cut and refused until it cools down
client.temp_warm: Transceiver warm ({temp}): watch the temperature, transmission will be cut at the second threshold
client.tx_mode_hint: Cannot transmit in {mode}: the station only allows {allowed}. Switch to {suggestion}.
client.data_mode_hint: The transceiver is in {mode}: to transmit this page's microphone over USB, switch to {target} mode. In {mode}, most transceivers modulate with their own microphone.
client.mic_err_notreadable: the microphone is busy or blocked by its driver: close the software that may be using it in exclusive mode (audio software, Breizh Audio Box…); if it stays blocked, unplug and replug the microphone and reconnect
client.mic_err_abort: the microphone did not start: unplug and replug it and reconnect
client.mic_err_notallowed: access denied: allow the microphone for this page (padlock in the address bar) and, on Windows, in Settings > Privacy > Microphone ("Let desktop apps access your microphone")
client.mic_err_security: access denied by the browser (HTTPS page required)
client.mic_err_notfound: no microphone found: check that it is plugged in and enabled in the Windows sound settings
client.mic_err_overconstrained: the selected microphone no longer exists (unplugged or renamed): select it again in the list
client.mic_refused: Microphone refused or missing ({name}). Receive only.
client.mic_refused_why: Microphone refused or missing ({name}): {why}. Receive only.
client.loss_datachannel_closed_explain: The control channel closed while the link was established: the station, the network or the VPN cut it.
client.loss_datachannel_closed_hint: Check the station log at the same time, then the VPN and the phone signal.
client.loss_connection_failed_explain: The network path (UDP) between the phone and the station is no longer usable.
client.loss_connection_failed_hint: Network change (Wi-Fi to 4G), VPN cut or restarted, or an expired port forward.
client.loss_connection_closed_explain: The browser closed the WebRTC link without being asked to.
client.loss_connection_closed_hint: Often a network change or Android putting the page to sleep.
client.loss_ice_failed_explain: The network connectivity check failed: no path between the phone and the station is usable any more.
client.loss_ice_failed_hint: Check the VPN, the firewall, and that the network does not block UDP traffic.
client.loss_silence_explain: No message has arrived for several seconds although the channel seemed open: frozen link, badly degraded network or suspended page.
client.loss_silence_hint: If the page was in the background or the screen locked, Android suspended it: keep it in the foreground, or use the app.
client.loss_no_hello_explain: The station answered, but the WebRTC link was not established in time: UDP traffic is most likely blocked.
client.loss_no_hello_hint: VPN that does not pass UDP, firewall, strict NAT or CGNAT: see docs/acces-distant.md.
client.loss_network_explain: The connection request did not reach the station.
client.loss_network_hint: Check the address, the VPN, Wi-Fi or 4G, and that the station is started.
client.loss_auth_explain: The station refused the username or password, or is temporarily blocking after too many attempts.
client.loss_auth_hint: Correct the password or wait a few minutes.
client.loss_busy_explain: The station has reached its maximum number of connections.
client.loss_refused_explain: The password is correct, but the station refuses this account for now (account disabled or expired, visitors full, operator absent).
client.loss_refused_hint: Read the station's message in the details.
client.loss_http_explain: The station answered with an HTTP error.
client.loss_client_error_explain: The browser could not prepare the WebRTC link.
client.loss_client_error_hint: Reload the page; if it persists, note the details below.
client.loss_tx_mine: (your transmission: cut by the station for lack of a sign of life)
client.loss_offline: the phone had NO network any more
client.no_stun: Station network configuration unavailable: connecting without a STUN server.
client.mic_needs_https: Microphone unavailable: an HTTPS page is required. Receive only.
client.mic_is_rig: Microphone REFUSED: "{label}" is an audio input/output of the transceiver itself (received audio would be sent back into the transmission). Choose another microphone, or tick "This is not the transceiver" if this is a mistake. Receive only.
client.link_unstable: Unstable network link (disconnected): it may recover on its own.
client.err_network: The station cannot be reached (network, VPN or wrong address).
client.err_auth: Username or password refused (or too many attempts: wait a few minutes).
client.err_busy: The station is busy (too many connections).
client.connect_impossible: Cannot connect: {cause}. Any transmission is cut by the station.
client.reconnected_one: Reconnected after {seconds} s ({n} attempt). Tick "Transmit allowed" again to transmit.
client.reconnected_other: Reconnected after {seconds} s ({n} attempts). Tick "Transmit allowed" again to transmit.
client.giveup_refused_why: access refused by the station (account, visitors full or operator absent)
client.wake_unavailable: Keep screen on unavailable (requires an HTTPS page and a recent browser): the screen will turn off.
client.wake_on: Screen kept on while this page is in the foreground.
client.wake_failed: Screen not kept on ({error}): battery saver mode?
client.calibrate_arm_first: Tick "Transmit allowed" first: automatic calibration is a transmission.
client.calibrate_tx_busy: A transmission is in progress ({owner}): calibration impossible.
client.selcall_arm_first: Tick "Transmit allowed" first: the SELCALL call is a transmission.
client.local_released: Control taken back: remote PTT is allowed again.
client.no_data_mode: The transceiver does not offer this data mode (USB-D or LSB-D).
client.mic_next_connection: Microphone setting applied at the next connection ({error}).
client.page_hidden_tx: Page hidden: transmission cut for safety.
ui.layout_unsupported: Layout: widget(s) not yet supported by this page, ignored: {widgets}
ui.layout_hidden: Layout: {n} widget(s) hidden, function missing on the transceiver.
ui.device_hidden_name: (name hidden until the microphone is allowed)
ui.output_is_rig: Audio output MUTED: "{device}" is an audio input of the transceiver (received audio would be fed into the transmitter). Choose another output, or tick "This is not the transceiver".
ui.keypad_hint: kHz if 1000 or more, otherwise MHz (e.g. 7074 or 14.205)
ui.band_title: {band} m band: last frequency and mode used
ui.loss_copy_failed: Copy impossible: select the report text by hand.
ui.spot_qsy_locked: QSY impossible: transmission in progress or station disconnected
ui.spot_qsy: Tune the rig to this spot
ui.kick_confirm: Disconnect "{name}"? (they can reconnect; to prevent this, disable their account on the station)
ui.listeners_close_confirm: Close visitor listening? The {count} connected visitor(s) will be disconnected.
ui.swr_outside_confirm: This range goes outside the amateur radio bands: you are about to transmit outside these bands, under your sole responsibility. Continue?
ui.replay_playing: TRANSMITTING THE RECORDING — STOP to stop
ui.net_thresholds_order: Thresholds refused: orange must be lower than red.
ui.net_thresholds_saved: Thresholds saved on the station for "{label}".
ui.net_stats_device: Measurements from this device; station local time.
ui.net_export_saved: Export saved: {name} (anonymous: attach it to a message for the development team).
ui.audio_blocked: Audio playback blocked by the browser: tap the screen.
ui.sel_update_station: Call and end-of-transmission burst: update the station (0.63.0 or later).
ui.voice_profile_prompt: Profile name (current equalizer, chorus and reverb, stored on the station):
ui.voice_profile_delete_confirm: Delete the profile "{name}" from the station?
ui.mic_digital_silence: The microphone delivers only digital silence: microphone muted (mute button, volume at 0 in Windows) or driver blocked (unplug and replug the microphone, then reconnect).
ui.mic_ended: The microphone stopped (unplugged or driver blocked): no more voice sent, reconnect.
ui.scrambler_warning:
SCRAMBLER: your voice becomes unintelligible to anyone without the same setting. This is NOT encryption: anyone with an identical scrambler can hear you.

On the amateur radio bands, the Radio Regulations (ITU, Art. 25) and national regulations prohibit transmissions intended to obscure the meaning of messages. You take FULL responsibility for this.
ui.scr_rate: Scrambler: audio at {rate} Hz (designed for 48 kHz): less clean decoding at the other end.
ui.scr_tx_failed: Transmit scrambler impossible ({error}): voice in CLEAR.
ui.rx_chain_failed: Receive processing impossible ({error}): reception without descrambling or spatialisation.
ui.rx_audio_waiting: Received audio waiting for the browser: tap the screen.
ui.scr_tx_pending: scrambled transmission as soon as connected with the microphone
ui.scr_rx_pending: reception descrambled as soon as connected
ui.scr_breizh_refused: Breizh Audio Box in use: transmit scrambler impossible (mutually exclusive). Choose "Direct" in the Breizh section to scramble.
ui.bzh_title: Breizh Audio Box: {text}. Tap: its section
ui.sdr_spot_touch: Tap: the SDR listens (the TRX does not move)
ui.sdr_spot_touch_first: Tap: the SDR listens to the first one (the TRX does not move)
ui.sdr_center_invalid: SDR: centre frequency unreadable (e.g. 14.100 in MHz).
ui.sdr_dfreq_invalid: SDR: listening frequency unreadable (e.g. 7.093 in MHz).
ui.sdr_audio_blocked: SDR audio blocked by the browser: tap the screen.
ui.sdr_split_st_off: TRX / SDR separation chosen: ST spatialisation off.
ui.sdr_qsy_unknown: QSY SDR → TRX: SDR listening frequency unknown.
ui.sdr_qsy_done: QSY SDR → TRX: TRX on {mhz} MHz.
ui.sdr_qsy_rev_unknown: QSY TRX → SDR: TRX frequency unknown.
ui.sdr_qsy_rev_done: QSY TRX → SDR: SDR on {mhz} MHz.
ui.fr_pip_refused: Detached window refused by the browser: the section stays in the page.
ui.fr_exclude_confirm: Exclude {pseudo} from the group "{group}"? A new key is given to the other members: {pseudo} will no longer read anything from the group.
ui.fr_text_refused: Text refused: 16 characters, unaccented letters, digits, space, . / -
ui.fr_copy_refused: Copy refused by the browser: select the link.
ui.fr_invite_valid: Valid {days} days, for ONE station only. It contains the group key: give it only to the invited person (in person, messaging, email).
ui.fr_paste_invitation: Paste the full invitation received from the group administrator.
ui.fr_create_note: You will be its administrator; then invite your friends (the group's "Invite" button).
ui.pseudo_refused: Nickname refused: 16 characters, unaccented letters, digits, space, . / _ -
ui.mo_digits_differ: Monitoring: digits differ, link refused and erased. Start again with a new code.
ui.mo_report_requested: Monitoring: report requested; the assisted operator must accept it.
ui.mo_report_preparing: Monitoring: report being prepared, it will be sent within a minute.
ui.st_split_off: ST spatialisation on: TRX / SDR separation off.
ui.st_waiting: "{preset}" as soon as audio is received
ui.st_headphones: Spatialisation: wear headphones to enjoy the effect (it cannot be heard on a single speaker).
ui.stop_hold_disconnect: STOP held 3 s: disconnecting from the station.
ui.cluster_every_15s: State received from the station every 15 s.
ui.report_copied: Report copied: paste it into an email or a message.
ui.report_copy_failed: Copy impossible: select the report text and copy it.
ui.ctl_no_level: The transceiver declares no adjustable level for this function.
